services.title: Transformers
services.short: Supply, installation and maintenance of distribution & power transformers.
services.intro: Reliable power starts with the right transformer. We supply, install, test and maintain oil-cooled and dry-type transformers for factories, commercial buildings, hospitals and infrastructure projects — sized correctly for your load and future expansion.

benefits.title: Right Sizing
benefits.text: Load study ensures you never over-pay or under-size.

benefits.title: Lower Losses
benefits.text: Energy-efficient units reduce running cost.

benefits.title: Longer Life
benefits.text: Regular testing & maintenance prevent failures.

services.title: Switchboards & Electrical Panels
services.short: LT/HT panels, MCC, PCC, distribution boards and switchgear.
services.intro: We design, manufacture and install robust LT & HT electrical panels and switchgear for safe, organised power distribution. Every panel is built with quality components, proper busbar sizing and complete testing before dispatch.
offerings: LT panels — PCC, MCC, APFC & distribution boards

benefits.title: Safe Distribution
benefits.text: Proper protection, interlocks and earthing.

benefits.title: Custom Built

services.title: Industrial Cables & Cabling

benefits.title: Correct Sizing

benefits.title: Tested Joints

faqs.question: What services does Damvolt Engineering Services Private Limited provide?
faqs.answer: We provide complete electrical and automation solutions — transformers, LT/HT panels and switchgear, industrial cabling, site testing, commissioning, machine automation, PLC/VFD/HMI panels, instrumentation and process control.

faqs.question: Do you take turnkey electrical projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle the full cycle — load study, design, supply, installation, testing, commissioning and handover documentation — under one contract.

faqs.question: Which areas do you serve?
faqs.answer: Our offices are in Noida and New Delhi, and we execute projects across Delhi NCR, Uttar Pradesh and other states in India.

faqs.question: Do you offer Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer AMC and preventive maintenance for transformers, panels, automation systems and complete electrical installations.

faqs.question: How can I get a quotation?
faqs.answer: Call us, WhatsApp us, or fill the enquiry form on the Contact page with your requirement. Our team usually responds within one working day.

faqs.question: Do you provide testing reports and certificates?
faqs.answer: Yes. After testing and commissioning we hand over detailed test reports, checklists and as-built documentation.

legal.title: Privacy Policy
legal.description: How Damvolt Engineering Services collects, uses and protects your information.
legal.content:
Damvolt Engineering Services Private Limited ("Damvolt", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use and protect information when you visit our website or contact us.

Information We Collect

  • Contact details you share with us, such as name, phone number, email address and company name.
  • Project details and requirements you send through our enquiry form, WhatsApp, email or phone.
  • Basic technical data such as browser type, device and pages visited, collected through standard server logs or analytics tools.

How We Use Your Information

  • To respond to your enquiries and prepare quotations.
  • To deliver, support and maintain the services you request.
  • To improve our website and services.
  • To comply with legal and regulatory obligations.

Sharing of Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share it only with trusted service partners who help us run our business (for example, equipment suppliers for a project you requested), or when required by law.

Data Security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information against unauthorised access, loss or misuse. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

Cookies

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to understand how visitors use the site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time.

Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us. We will respond in accordance with the applicable laws of India, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page.

legal.title: Service Policy
legal.description: How Damvolt delivers, supports and maintains its electrical and automation services.
legal.content:
This Service Policy describes how Damvolt Engineering Services Private Limited plans, executes and supports the work it undertakes. Draft — please review and edit before publishing.

Scope of Service

The scope, specifications, timelines and commercial terms of every project are defined in the written quotation / work order accepted by the client. Work outside that scope is treated as a variation and quoted separately.

Site Survey & Execution

  • A site survey is carried out before the final quotation wherever required.
  • Work is executed by trained technicians following applicable IS/IEC standards and site-safety practices.
  • Progress updates are shared as agreed in the work order.

Testing & Handover

On completion, systems are tested and commissioned, and test reports and handover documentation are provided.

Warranty & After-Sales Support

Equipment carries the manufacturer's warranty. Workmanship warranty, AMC and breakdown support are provided as defined in the project agreement.

Cancellation & Changes

Requests to change or cancel an order must be made in writing. Materials already procured or custom-built for the order may be chargeable.

legal.title: Shipping Policy
legal.description: Shipping and delivery terms for electrical equipment supplied by Damvolt.
legal.content:
This Shipping Policy applies to electrical equipment, panels and materials supplied by Damvolt Engineering Services Private Limited. Draft — please review and edit before publishing.

Dispatch Timelines

Dispatch timelines are mentioned in the quotation / work order. Custom-built panels are dispatched after in-house testing and client approval, where applicable.

Shipping Charges & Transit

  • Freight and insurance are as specified in the quotation.
  • Delivery is made to the site address given in the order.
  • Risk passes to the client on delivery unless agreed otherwise in writing.

Inspection on Delivery

Please inspect goods on receipt and report any transit damage or shortage in writing within 48 hours, with photographs, so that a claim can be raised with the carrier.

Delays

Delivery dates are estimates and may be affected by circumstances beyond our control. We will inform you promptly of any delay.
